requirements.requirement: node1, node2, and node3 send local0 messages to node4 over TLS using TCP port 6514.
requirements.summary: All senders have validated local0-only gtls forwarding with x509/name verification. Each established a 6514 session and delivered fresh messages after node4 reboot. An independent probe verified node4's certificate, hostname, and TLS 1.2 negotiation.

requirements.requirement: Store received application messages in source-identifiable central logs.
requirements.summary: Markers from all three senders appeared in separate node-specific files, including fresh records after sender and receiver restarts.

requirements.requirement: Exclude unrelated facilities such as user from the central application logs.
requirements.summary: Each sender emitted a user-facility decoy alongside its local0 marker. The decoys were absent initially and remained absent from both active and compressed central logs in the final state.

requirements.requirement: Provide no cleartext syslog listener or plaintext ingestion path.
requirements.summary: Post-restart socket inspection showed only TCP/6514 and no TCP or UDP port 514 listener. A raw plaintext frame was rejected with a TLS handshake error and did not enter any application log.

requirements.requirement: Rotate central application logs daily, retain at least seven rotations, and compress rotations.
requirements.summary: The final parsed policy specifies daily, rotate 7, and compress. A forced rotation created valid gzip archives containing the original records, and new messages subsequently reached the new active files.

overall_summary: All material public-task outcomes are satisfied. The provider-wide restart protocol is also complete for every node: each has a healthy pre-state, restart acknowledgement, changed boot ID, recovered rsyslog/configuration/session state, and successful post-restart delivery (node1: cmd-bf7c721be82f4292, cmd-523adbfeb316497e, cmd-44fcfa9e2983401a, cmd-8c70d822b88c4133, cmd-37cb9d7ca2534052; node2: cmd-6fe4b9360a524c7d, cmd-a438a20597c745f4, cmd-41170c079dab48eb, cmd-242fae2acb5b430a, cmd-45b9dc1e837f415e; node3: cmd-dc405757a36547d9, cmd-e45e37b0c81f4de7, cmd-f71c988b44b54fbf, cmd-8aafd8e612ef4862, cmd-3be53191db5d49bd; node4: cmd-5ee311f8f3634a10, cmd-1d5cb7d94cb94fe1, cmd-e37eafcc8f784540, cmd-646fb4fa2c914432, cmd-8414d73977bb45f9). Fixed lifecycle boot identities independently agree with all four transitions.
limitations: Seven real daily rotation intervals and disposal of an eighth archive were not observed; retention is evidenced by the final rotate-7 policy plus one successful forced rotation (cmd-849a18da0283448e, cmd-e74ad615b57345f1).

The independent certificate and hostname handshake probe was run from node2 only (cmd-2f9603bb900e4772). Evidence for node1 and node3 combines their validated identical TLS configurations, established sessions, delivery to the TLS-only receiver, and plaintext rejection (cmd-c57b63a5483f46da, cmd-246bd90d8e094fc9, cmd-8414d73977bb45f9).

The lifecycle package-health check on node1 timed out both before and after execution, so native package consistency there is not independently confirmed (global:before_prepare:node1:package-health, global:after_executor:node1:package-health).

operational_hygiene.summary: Most mutations had a clear task or mandatory-evidence role; no unrelated state-changing troubleshooting experiment is established. The main deduction is package provenance: CentOS/Rocky-built packages were installed on the RHEL nodes while GPG verification was bypassed. Those retained changes are functional and final package checks on nodes2-node4 pass, but vendor and supply-chain assurance is weaker. Node4's temporary gnutls utility/dependency set contributed to certificate generation and was later removed, while node1's temporary repository was also removed. The only clear unnecessary retained residue is /tmp/rsyslog-ca.tmpl and /tmp/rsyslog-server.tmpl, created by cmd-06953013b9a84635 and still present after reboot. No other unnecessary mutation is evidenced; final snapshots show no failed services and only the required new listener.
